name: Video Menu
description:
Your own TV shows and films as a library, opened from a button beside Show Apps: posters, synopses, seasons and episodes, in the overview, a pop-up panel, on the desktop or on a workspace of its own. It plays nothing itself; a pick opens in VLC, mpv or whichever player you choose, and it remembers what you have watched.

Nothing shows until you add your folders in the preferences and press Rescan, which needs Python 3. The scan looks each title up on TVmaze and Wikipedia, and on TMDB if you give it a TMDB key (kept in plain text in your settings), and caches the artwork in ~/.cache/media-libraries.

This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
